addonDescription.message: Sets a default font of your choice for every new composed e-mail.

fontFamilyOption.description: Option name for the default font family in new e-mails.

fontFamilyHelp.message: Comma-separated list of font family names in order of preference. Enclose names containing spaces in single quotes. In case the recipient has none of these fonts installed, end with a generic family name, e.g., `sans-serif` or `serif`.
fontFamilyHelp.description: Help for the font family option.

fontSizeOption.description: Option name for the default font size in new e-mails.

fontSizeHelp.description: Help for the font size option.
